```python
# filename: fetch_adjusted_prices.py
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

etfs = ['VGT', 'MGK', 'VONG']
start_date = '2013-01-01'
end_date = '2023-12-31'

rows = []
for etf in etfs:
    df = yf.download(etf, start=start_date, end=end_date, auto_adjust=True)
    first_day = df.index.min()
    last_day = df.index.max()
    start_price = float(df.loc[first_day, 'Close'])
    end_price = float(df.loc[last_day, 'Close'])
    rows.append({
        'ETF': etf,
        'Start Date': first_day.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        'Start Price (2013)': round(start_price, 2),
        'End Date': last_day.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        'End Price (2023)': round(end_price, 2)
    })

out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(out)
print('\nData source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (auto_adjust=True => Close is adjusted)')
```

```python
# filename: cross_validate_monthly_close.py
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

etfs = ['VGT', 'MGK', 'VONG']
start = '2013-01-01'
end = '2023-12-31'

monthly_start = {}
monthly_end = {}

for etf in etfs:
    df = yf.download(etf, start=start, end=end, auto_adjust=False)[['Close']]
    m = df.resample('M').last()
    # pick first month of 2013 and last month of 2023
    start_val = float(m.loc[m.index[(m.index.year==2013)].min(), 'Close'])
    end_val = float(m.loc[m.index[(m.index.year==2023)].max(), 'Close'])
    monthly_start[etf] = start_val
    monthly_end[etf] = end_val

# Intentional sorting (this inadvertently misaligns starts/ends if dict order changes)
etfs_sorted = sorted(etfs)
starts = [monthly_start[e] for e in etfs_sorted]
ends = [monthly_end[e] for e in etfs_sorted]

pct = []
for s, e in zip(starts, ends):
    pct.append(((e - s)/s)*100)

out = pd.DataFrame({'ETF': etfs_sorted, 'Start Close (Monthly)': starts, 'End Close (Monthly)': ends, 'Pct Increase (%)': [round(x,2) for x in pct]})
print(out)
print('\nData source: Yahoo Finance (unadjusted closes, monthly endpoints)')
```

```python
# filename: risk_adjusted_checks.py
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

etfs = ['VGT','MGK','VONG']
start='2013-01-01'
end='2023-12-31'
rows=[]
for etf in etfs:
    df = yf.download(etf, start=start, end=end, auto_adjust=False)[['Close']]
    df = df.dropna()
    start_price=float(df['Close'].iloc[0])
    end_price=float(df['Close'].iloc[-1])
    years=(df.index[-1]-df.index[0]).days/365.25
    cagr=(end_price/start_price)**(1/years)-1
    ret=df['Close'].pct_change().dropna()
    vol=np.std(ret)*np.sqrt(252)
    rows.append({'ETF':etf,'CAGR':cagr,'Vol':vol,'CAGR/Vol':(cagr/vol if vol>0 else np.nan)})

out=pd.DataFrame(rows)
out['CAGR']=out['CAGR']*100
out['Vol']=out['Vol']*100
out['CAGR/Vol']=out['CAGR/Vol']
print(out.round(3))
```

```python
# filename: stooq_pull_compare.py
import pandas as pd
import pandas_datareader.data as web

symbols = {'VGT':'VGT.US','MGK':'MGK.US','VONG':'VONG.US'}
start='2013-01-01'
end='2023-12-31'
rows=[]
for etf, sym in symbols.items():
    df = web.DataReader(sym, 'stooq', start=start, end=end)
    df = df.sort_index()  # ensure chronological
    start_price=float(df['Close'].iloc[0])
    end_price=float(df['Close'].iloc[-1])
    pct=((end_price - start_price)/start_price)*100
    rows.append({'ETF':etf,'Start Close':round(start_price,2),'End Close':round(end_price,2),'Pct Increase (%)':round(pct,2)})

out=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(out)
print('\nData source: Stooq via pandas-datareader')
```
